setup: Each side: npm run build in studio/frontend (dist is gitignored; git status clean on both), CPU-only Unsloth Studio (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=, UNSLOTH_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1) with fresh home under /mnt/disks/unslothai/etherl/sandboxes/r3-ui/ev-{base,head}; Chromium (Playwright 1.63) 1280px wide, DPR 2, light, reduced motion, en-US, UTC.

ports.head: 18942, then 18962. My head Studio on 18942 was shut down by something outside this run partway through, and another session's Studio (integ-m1) then bound 18942. I left it alone and relaunched head on 18962 with the same worktree and sandbox. s6/s7 head shots come from 18962; the rest are from 18942.

mocked_scenes.s1 fit-description (after only): GET /api/settings/multi-model mocked to {enabled:true, default_enabled:false, mode:'fit', default_mode:'off'}; the backend in this build returns only {enabled, default_enabled}, so without the mock the Select shows Off.
mocked_scenes.s4, s5, s6, s7 (both sides): page.route mocks /api/inference/images/download-plan (no files to fetch), /load POST, /load-progress, /status. s4: POST held pending, load-progress phase 'saving_chat_context'. s5: POST answers a real DiffusionStatus body + evicted/evicted_slots, then load-progress 'ready' and a loaded status. s6/s7: POST 409 with X-Unsloth-Refusal: multi-model-always and the detail sentence from the brief. Model chosen by deep link /images?model=unsloth/Z-Image-Turbo-GGUF&quant=z-image-turbo-Q4_K_M.gguf.
mocked_scenes.real (not mocked): s1 Select/Switch, s1 de/ru at UI size 20, s2, s3, and the managed account in s6. The managed account 'reviewer' was created through POST /api/accounts as the owner, signed in with the setup code, then its password was changed through /api/auth/change-password.

notes: Before (main) Model memory description with the Switch off reads 'Loading a model keeps the others in memory.'; after reads 'Loading a chat, image or video model unloads the other ones.' for Off.

Managed refusal uses the same owner sentence as the brief. The managed-copy sentence comes from the backend parent, which is not in this build. The frontend matches on the header, so the missing action depends only on the owner check.
Head became multi-user once the managed account existed, so the head s6-owner and s7 shots ran in login_mode=multi; base stayed single-user.
s7: after Open settings, the dialog is on the System tab and the Model memory heading sits at y=182 of an 860px viewport. It is in view, though not flush with the top.
Language and UI size are synced to the server per account. The de/ru variants set them through a real PUT /api/settings/personalization, and they were reset to auto/default afterwards.
The only console errors are 503 /api/rag/reembed (both sides, unrelated) and the 409 the scenes ask for.
not_produced: Scene 4 before: main has no saving phase. The before panel shows main's plain 'Starting model... Loading the model.' toast under the same mocks.
Scene 6 managed before: not captured. The brief asks for after only, and main has no Open settings action for anyone.
head_worktree_drift: Another session moved integ-r3 off 0500dbb4 during this run (WIP commits from 13:22:29, then reset and squash to 2fc1ef238d at 13:33:51 PDT). The frontend dist served in every AFTER shot was built at 13:21:08 from 0500dbb4. Between 0500dbb4 and 2fc1ef23 the only frontend change is tests/load-refusal-header.test.ts, so the UI is 0500dbb4's. The head backend Python came from the moving worktree at launch, which included small gpu_arbiter.py and chat_swap_kv.py changes. No scene depends on them: the multi-model, personalization and auto-switch settings GETs are unchanged, and the Images endpoints are mocked.
